decoder.mechanism: preserve the frozen seeded area-balanced two-means handoff, then apply a bounded deterministic local reassignment of groups that are closer to the opposite area-weighted center
decoder.decision: flip only a small area- and count-capped set of high-margin wrong-side groups, preserving the reference global orientation and macro-feasibility neighborhood
decoder.prediction: timing-weighted cut and combined score should improve where reference area rounding left boundary groups on the wrong side, without the large swings caused by global label flips
decoder.falsifier: matched-case combined score fails to improve while the selected flips are absent or the timing-weighted cut does not fall.
